channels.contactMeaning: Proposed finite rectangular inner-sidewall patches; actual contact topology and area are returned by the field mesh.

geometry.censusMeaning: Declared synthetic original census H and distinct equal-size engineered census E; each is an explicit fixed-topology scenario.
geometry.capacityMeaning: Candidate center positions only. Every stated cell has one explicit physical well; only the selected channel pairs are driven.

method: Complete predeclared amplitude grid. Same imposed transfer and initial state; all four interventions attempted for every cell. Rejected trials remain failures, never non-recruitment.
